intent: Fix `./lint_python.sh` from the repo root, which the preceding split broke: the root path is a symlink into meta/, and SCRIPT_DIR did not resolve it, so the new source line pointed at a lib/ that does not exist.
scope: Non-goal: no change to which linters run or to any output
changes: Resolve SCRIPT_DIR with `dirname "$(readlink -f "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")"` instead of a bare dirname, matching the pattern nvidia_troubleshoot.sh already uses in this repo.

verification.command: ./lint_python.sh --help (from the repo root, via the symlink) -- BEFORE the fix
verification.evidence: exit 1: './lint_python.sh: line 31: /home/kuhy/testsAndMisc/lib/lint_output.sh: No such file or directory'. Under set -euo pipefail this is an immediate hard exit. Pre-split, SCRIPT_DIR only fed PROJECT_ROOT, so a root-path invocation degraded quietly instead of dying.
exit 0 both times; the full-mode run reports all six available linters passing (ruff-lint, ruff-format-check, mypy, pylint, flake8, pycodestyle).

verification.command: bash meta/lint_python.sh scripts/check_requirements_sync.py, diffed against the pre-split baseline captured in a detached worktree
verification.evidence: DIRECT PATH IDENTICAL TO PRE-SPLIT BASELINE -- byte-identical, so resolving the symlink did not shift PROJECT_ROOT for the direct invocation.

No hits: no CI job, hook or wrapper invokes it, so the broken commit did not break an automated path. It is documented as a root-path entry point in README.md and CLAUDE.md, which is how a human would hit it.

risks: PROJECT_ROOT is now meta/ for symlink invocations too, rather than the repo root. That is the same value the direct invocation always used, and the direct-path output is byte-identical to the pre-split baseline, so the two entry points now agree instead of diverging.

The general lesson, recorded in the handoff: a script reachable through a symlink must be verified through that symlink. Every check on the original split used `bash meta/lint_python.sh`, the one path that could not fail.
rollback: Revert to the bare dirname; `./lint_python.sh` from the repo root breaks again.
